disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 逐字通读了插件全部文本文件（后端入口、浏览器端脚本、挂载配置、README 与清单），未发现读取 dsh 凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭证等敏感路径的代码。
checked_items.en: Carefully read all text files of the plugin (backend entry, browser-side script, patch config, README and manifest), found no code reading sensitive paths such as dsh credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, etc.

checked_items.zh: 检查了硬编码密钥与口令痕迹，未检出任何密钥、令牌或口令字面量。
checked_items.en: Checked for hardcoded credentials and password traces; no key, token, or password literals detected.

evidence.zh: 本插件不读取任何凭据，也不发起任何外部网络请求（浏览器端唯一请求指向本机 /dsh-alive/ping 状态端点），凭据外泄所需的读取面与外联面均不存在，场景不适用。
evidence.en: This plugin does not read any credentials, nor does it initiate any external network requests (the only browser-side request points to the local /dsh-alive/ping status endpoint). The read surface and outbound surface required for credential exfiltration are both absent; scenario not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件注册的所有模型工具与系统提示词注入点：本插件未注册任何模型工具，也未注入系统提示词段落；浏览器端只注册一个会话头部 UI 槽位，文案为在线状态文字，不含任何指令性内容。
checked_items.en: Checked all model tools and system prompt injection points registered by the plugin: this plugin does not register any model tools, nor does it inject system prompt paragraphs; the browser side only registers a session header UI slot with text being online status, containing no directive content.

checked_items.zh: 全树搜索了技能文件、代理说明、编辑器规则等模型指令文件，未发现此类文件；README 与代码注释均为正常功能说明，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息或诱导安装的措辞。
checked_items.en: Thoroughly searched the entire tree for skill files, agent instructions, editor rules, and other model directive files; no such files found. The README and code comments are all normal functional descriptions; no directive overwriting, disguised system messages, or installation-inducing wording found.

evidence.zh: 插件没有注册任何模型工具，不存在工具描述进入模型请求的投毒面；浏览器端注入的 UI 槽位（client/client.js）仅显示在线状态文字，未检出指令性内容。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any model tools, so there is no poisoning surface where tool descriptions enter model requests; the browser-side injected UI slot (client/client.js) only displays online status text, no directive content detected.

evidence.zh: 插件没有工具描述文本，不存在通过工具文本诱导安装或改写配置的入口，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin has no tool description text, so there is no entry point for inducing installation or modifying configuration through tool text; scenario not applicable.

evidence.zh: 插件未挂接模型输入守门事件，不具备改写或注入每步领取的用户消息的能力，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not hook into the model input gate event, and does not have the ability to modify or inject user messages at each step; scenario not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与挂载配置：未发现动态求值、远程代码加载、子进程或命令执行调用；挂载配置为纯声明，不含可执行脚本。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and patch config: no dynamic evaluation, remote code loading, subprocess, or command execution calls found; the patch config is purely declarative, containing no executable scripts.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件清单，未发现安装期钩子（安装前/安装后/准备脚本），也未发现树内可执行载体；浏览器端脚本仅做本地状态轮询与 UI 渲染。
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin manifest: no install hooks (pre-install, post-install, prepare scripts) found, and no executable payloads within the tree; the browser-side script only performs local status polling and UI rendering.

checked_items.zh: 对浏览器端 bundle 做了客户端专项核查：未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或调用宿主特权接口的行为。
checked_items.en: Conducted a client-specific check on the browser-side bundle: no keyboard monitoring, clipboard reading, or calls to host privileged interfaces found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 为纯声明（仅插入插件自身条目），不含可执行标签，不存在配置即执行路径。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml is purely declarative (only inserts the plugin's own entry), contains no executable tags, and has no configuration-as-execution path.

evidence.zh: 插件未使用动态包定义/运行能力（无相关调用），不存在让模型代码在宿主进程执行的面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not use dynamic package definition/running capabilities (no related calls), so there is no surface for allowing model code to execute in the host process; scenario not applicable.

evidence.zh: 插件清单 package.json 没有任何安装期钩子，树内也不存在 git 钩子、CI 工作流、开发容器等可执行载体。
evidence.en: The plugin manifest package.json has no install hooks, and the tree contains no git hooks, CI workflows, dev containers, or other executable payloads.

evidence.zh: 清单声明了客户端 bundle（dsh.client）；已核查该脚本（client/client.js）仅轮询本地状态端点并渲染状态点，无键盘、剪贴板或凭据接口调用。
evidence.en: The manifest declares a client bundle (dsh.client); the script (client/client.js) has been verified to only poll the local status endpoint and render a status dot, with no keyboard, clipboard, or credential interface calls.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册子代理提供方，不存在把轮次委派给进程外产品的面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register a sub-agent provider, so there is no surface for delegating turns to out-of-process products; scenario not applicable.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册后台任务、定时任务或持久目标；浏览器端 15 秒轮询是页面内计时器，不属于宿主持驻机制，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register background tasks, scheduled tasks, or persistent targets; the browser-side 15-second polling is an in-page timer, not a host persistent mechanism; scenario not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了插件全部网络请求：仅浏览器端对本地 /dsh-alive/ping 状态端点的轮询（相对地址、同源），未发现任何外部域名、裸 IP 或隧道式外发通道。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network requests of the plugin: only the browser-side polling of the local /dsh-alive/ping status endpoint (relative URL, same-origin); no external domains, bare IPs, or tunneled exfiltration channels found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了代码中的编码与混淆痕迹：未发现编码外发、隐藏信道或改写模型服务地址/代理的端点劫持代码。
checked_items.en: Checked for encoding and obfuscation traces in the code: no encoded exfiltration, hidden channels, or endpoint hijacking code that modifies model service address/proxy found.

evidence.zh: 插件未挂接模型请求路由事件，也未注册自定义模型适配器，不存在运行时把对话重路由到其他端点的入口，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not hook into model request routing events, nor does it register a custom model adapter; there is no entry point for rerouting conversations to other endpoints at runtime; scenario not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件清单：没有任何第三方依赖，供应链面仅剩插件自身文件；无安装钩子，无动态拉取并执行远程脚本的安装流程。
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin manifest: no third-party dependencies, the supply chain surface is limited to the plugin's own files; no install hooks, no dynamic fetching and execution of remote scripts in the installation process.

checked_items.zh: 核查了挂载配置：只声明插入插件自身条目，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未禁用任何安全项，也未改写注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Verified the patch config: only declares insertion of the plugin's own entry, does not touch sandbox, approval, permission, or other security configuration settings; does not disable any security items, nor modify injection or interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 检查了作者与仓库身份信息：仓库名与插件名一致，未发现与官方或热门插件撞名的仿冒迹象；本插件为首次审计，无历史版本可对比。
checked_items.en: Checked author and repository identity information: repository name matches the plugin name; no signs of impersonation by name collision with official or popular plugins; this is the first audit of this plugin, with no historical versions for comparison.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅插入插件自身条目，未触碰或禁用沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，也未使用环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml only inserts the plugin's own entry, does not touch or disable sandbox, approval, permission, or other security configuration settings, and does not use environment variable privilege downgrade writing.

evidence.zh: 插件未挂接审批请求或工具执行前事件，不存在截断审批链的可能，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not hook into approval request or pre-tool execution events; there is no possibility of truncating the approval chain; scenario not applicable.

evidence.zh: 本插件为首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较，无法评估升级自动激活突变，场景不适用。
evidence.en: This is the first audit of this plugin, with no previous version baseline for comparison; cannot assess upgrade auto-activation mutation; scenario not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加不存在的必需服务使其挂起的可能。
evidence.en: The patch config does not modify injection or interception configurations; there is no possibility of adding a non-existent required service to a security plugin to cause it to hang.

checked_items.zh: 核查了插件注册的 HTTP 端点：/dsh-alive/ping 仅返回在线状态与时间戳，不读写数据、不调用特权接口；端点无鉴权属宿主本机服务固有形态，但该端点本身无敏感能力。
checked_items.en: Verified the HTTP endpoint registered by the plugin: /dsh-alive/ping only returns online status and timestamp, does not read/write data, does not call privileged interfaces; the lack of authentication on the endpoint is inherent to the host's local service, but the endpoint itself has no sensitive capabilities.

checked_items.zh: 本次审计未提供动态沙箱运行产物，未做动态验证，运行时行为以静态核查为准。
checked_items.en: This audit did not provide dynamic sandbox execution artifacts; no dynamic verification was performed; runtime behavior is based on static inspection.

evidence.zh: 插件在宿主 Web 服务上注册了一个本机状态端点（dsh/index.js），返回内容仅为 ok 与时间戳，无任何敏感操作；宿主 Web 服务无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin registers a local status endpoint (dsh/index.js) on the host web service, returning only "ok" and a timestamp, with no sensitive operations; the lack of authentication on the host web service is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 插件清单与身份信息核验通过：dsh 声明合法、无仿冒迹象、无安装钩子。
summary.en: Verification of the plugin manifest and identity information passed: the dsh declaration is legitimate, no signs of impersonation, no install hooks.

summary.zh: 静态扫描全部源码与配置，未命中危险执行、凭据、注入或外联模式（预扫 0 命中）。
summary.en: Static scan of all source code and configuration: no hits on dangerous execution, credentials, injection, or outbound patterns (pre-scan 0 hits).

summary.zh: 行为面核查：无安装期钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取、无外部网络外发。
summary.en: Behavioral surface check: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive path reads, no external network exfiltration.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：插件未注册模型工具或系统提示词段落，浏览器端 UI 文案无注入迹象。
summary.en: AI metadata review: the plugin does not register model tools or system prompt paragraphs; the browser-side UI text shows no signs of injection.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本次审计未提供动态运行产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (this audit did not provide dynamic execution artifacts).

target.zh: dsh-alive@0.1.1#b89e53b5（首版审计，无基线，仓库根）
target.en: dsh-alive@0.1.1#b89e53b5 (first audit, no baseline, repo root)

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本次未提供动态运行产物）。插件清单未声明能力字段，能力声明按代码实测推断（network/shell/fs/modelFacing 均为否）。README 声称兼容 dsh 0.1.0-rc.6（web profile），本次未做运行时验证。源码树很小（4 个文本文件），已全部逐字精读，无未核验路径。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (no dynamic execution artifacts provided for this audit). The plugin manifest does not declare capability fields; capability declarations are inferred from code inspection (network/shell/fs/modelFacing are all No). The README claims compatibility with dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (web profile); no runtime verification performed in this audit. The source tree is small (4 text files), all have been read verbatim, with no unchecked paths.
